log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Show solar PV capacity additions in MW across market segments, countries and the first two quarters of 2024.","tasks":["Look up a segment’s addition for a country and quarter.","Compare quarters within a country and corresponding quarters across countries.","Compare segment contributions with each country-quarter total."],"relations":["Europe groups Germany and France; Asia-Pacific groups Japan and Australia.","Each country has Q1 and Q2 columns, and each data row supplies values for all four countries.","The Total row aggregates the segments for each country-quarter."],"roles":["The first column identifies segments and the total; its header spans the three header tiers.","Regional and country headers group the quarterly columns beneath them.","Quarter headers identify the individual measures; numeric cells contain additions in MW."],"keep_whole":["Numbers, including thousands separators.","Quarter identifiers Q1 and Q2.","Country and region names, including Asia-Pacific.","Utility-scale and the other unbreakable units in segment labels."],"may_wrap":["Multiword segment labels may wrap at spaces, keeping their reading order natural."],"same_scale":["Quarter columns serve the same role and should have broadly comparable widths, while allowing for differences in numeric content.","Region and country headers derive their widths from their grouped columns.","The segment column needs a different scale from the numeric columns because its labels are longer."],"h_vs_v":"The viewport cannot accommodate every segment label on one line while preserving all numeric values. Giving the segment column more width can reduce wrapping; giving the quarterly columns more room produces a more open numeric grid at the cost of taller label rows."},"designs":[{"widths":[144,61,61,54,59,59,59,49,59],"strategy":"Give the segment labels all available spare width, using content-fitting quarterly columns to limit row wrapping."},{"widths":[124,62,62,58,61,61,61,54,62],"strategy":"Balance label space with a broadly even quarterly grid, accepting some label wrapping for a more regular comparison area."},{"widths":[107,67,67,60,64,63,64,54,59],"strategy":"Keep the segment column at its unbreakable-content minimum and devote the remaining space to a more open numeric grid, especially Germany’s columns."}]}
